items.title: AbbVie races into F1 as pharma companies continue push into sport
items.summary: AbbVie is just one of several pharmaceutical companies to pen sponsorship deals in sport, blurring the commercial line between the two industries.

items.title: Pharma’s supplier sprawl problem: When more vendors create less control
items.summary: Consolidating complicated supply chains with trusted providers reduces governance, sharpens cost and emissions insight, and creates a more resilient, coordinated network.

items.title: FDA approves Cosette’s Evoxac oral solution for Sjögren’s disease
items.summary: The FDA has granted approval for Cosette’s Evoxac oral solution to treat dry mouth symptoms in adults diagnosed with Sjögren’s disease.

items.title: MHRA revokes approval for Valneva’s Ixchiq due to safety frailties
items.summary: The market withdrawal caps a tumultuous few years for the chikungunya vaccine amid related adverse events.

items.title: Sanofi and ScionxBio partner on mRNA therapies
items.summary: Sanofi has signed a global licensing and strategic collaboration agreement with ScionxBio to develop long-acting mRNA therapies using the TERA platform.
